new_page.title: Coquitlam Houses for Sale | Burke Mountain & More
new_page.description: Search Coquitlam detached houses for sale. Compare Burke Mountain, Westwood Plateau and Central Coquitlam sold prices, and check the city’s R-1 to R-4 zones.

faq.q: What does a house cost in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was $1,600,000 over the year to October 22, 2026, at $538 a square foot. The middle half of sales ran from $1,393,500 to $1,875,750.

faq.q: Is Burke Mountain more expensive than Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Burke Mountain’s median was $1,954,000 against $1,564,000 in Central Coquitlam, on a smaller median lot (5,042 sq ft against 7,920 sq ft).

faq.q: How many units can a Coquitlam lot take?
faq.a: Up to 3 on a lot of 280 square metres or less and up to 4 on a larger lot under 4,050 square metres. There is no 6-unit tier because the City has no bus stops that meet the frequent-service rule.

faq.q: Can I build a carriage house in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Carriage houses are one of the forms the City’s small-scale rules allow, along with laneway homes, garden cottages and secondary suites, in the R-1 to R-4 zones. Check the lot’s zone and minimum lot size.

faq.q: How fast do Coquitlam houses sell?
faq.a: 24 days at a median. The sold price was 96.2% of list at a median.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam lots have creek rules?
faq.a: Lots within 30 metres of the top of bank of a watercourse need a Watercourse Protection Development Permit. If there is a creek on or next to the lot, call Development Services before you design.

blocks.text: This search lists detached houses for sale in Coquitlam, from Coquitlam West and Central Coquitlam to Burke Mountain. Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

470 Coquitlam houses sold in the year to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,600,000. Newer Burke Mountain houses were built around 2014, against 1972 for Central Coquitlam, and the price gap between the two is $390,000.

blocks.text: Central Coquitlam had the most house sales, 88, followed by Burke Mountain with 58 and Westwood Plateau with 57. Among neighbourhoods with 10 or more sales, Burke Mountain had the highest median at $1,954,000 and New Horizons the lowest at $1,200,000. New Horizons, at a median lot of 4,101 sq ft, is the compact end of the market.

blocks.text: Burke Mountain’s newer streets carry minimum subdivision sizes of 650 square metres and 18.5 metres of frontage in the R-1 and R-3 zones, and 465 square metres and 12.5 metres in R-2. Westwood Plateau is a master-planned community of 2,309 hectares and about 19,775 people. Coquitlam East had 48 sales at $1,702,450, and the quickest sale among the five busiest neighbourhoods was Coquitlam East, at 12 days.
The October 2026 monthly report counted 378 detached houses for sale in Coquitlam and 54 sold, a sales ratio of 14%. The median was $1,534,400.

blocks.text: Coquitlam’s zoning bylaw is No. 3000, and Council adopted the small-scale multi-unit housing changes on June 9, 2025. A lot of 280 square metres or smaller can take up to 3 units; a lot over 280 and under 4,050 square metres can take up to 4. The 6-unit tier near frequent buses does not apply, because the City says Coquitlam has no bus stops that meet the provincial frequent-service rule.

Most low-density lots now sit in R-1, R-2, R-3 or R-4, each with its own minimum lot size for adding units, from 465 square metres in R-2 to 930 square metres in R-4. The forms allowed include secondary suites, carriage houses, laneway homes, garden cottages, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes.

Talk to the City’s Development Services before you design anything if there is a creek on or next to the lot, a steep slope, or a house built before 1945. A Watercourse Protection Development Permit applies within 30 metres of the top of bank. The Interim Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 5511, was adopted April 27, 2026.

Coquitlam’s 2026 municipal residential rate is $2.2756 per $1,000 of assessed value, $3.8520 with the other taxing authorities. Taxes were due July 2, 2026. Coquitlam is a Speculation and Vacancy Tax area.
